preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'air' if not any(word in input_str.lower() for word in ['water', 'wet', 'wash']) and 'i don\'t know' not in input_str.lower() and 'slime' not in input_str.lower() else True
postconditions.description: If none of the forbidden words or phrases are present, the output is 'air'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'water' if any(word in input_str.lower() for word in ['water', 'wet', 'wash']) and 'i don\'t know' not in input_str.lower() and 'slime' not in input_str.lower() else True
postconditions.description: If any of the forbidden words are present but not the phrases, the output is 'water'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'slime' if 'i don\'t know' in input_str.lower() or 'slime' in input_str.lower() and not any(word in input_str.lower() for word in ['water', 'wet', 'wash']) else True
postconditions.description: If any of the forbidden phrases are present but not the words, the output is 'slime'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'sludge' if any(word in input_str.lower() for word in ['water', 'wet', 'wash']) and ('i don\'t know' in input_str.lower() or 'slime' in input_str.lower()) else True
postconditions.description: If both forbidden words and phrases are present, the output is 'sludge'.
